title: Jasmine, 17:
title_short: Jasmine · Nobody Can Mess Up My Day
headline: A shy girl learned to walk with her head high. Today she got new shoes, and nobody can mess up her day.
story: Jasmine is 17 and in 12th grade. She got her shoes at the event. She opens with pure joy: “I just got new shoes. Nobody can mess up my day.”

Then her story: she used to be introverted and didn't like to talk to people. Seven years in her youth group, Girls Taking Action, and now she has more confidence in her own body and can walk with her head high. The shoes are the last step: she will wear them to school and look cool enough. She ends with thank you. Happy and respectful the whole way.
